newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Megaworld says to redevelop condominium.
newsitem.headline: Megaworld says to redevelop condominium.

text.p: Megaworld Properties and Holdings Inc said on Monday it has signed a joint venture for the redevelopment of a condominium in Manila's Makati commercial district.

The real estate developer said in a statement it forged a joint venture with the unit owners of the four-story Sedeno Manor residential and commercial building to demolish the structure to give way to the construction of a luxury high-rise residential condominium tower in the area.
"The project will be part of an integrated residential and commercial redevelopment that Megaworld will undertake in the Makati central business district," it said.
The redevelopment involves a prime property block that is almost one hectare in size and right in front of the Philippine Stock Exchange building in Makati, it added.
The residential-commercial project will be launched within the year, Megaworld said.
